name: get_cart
description: Get the live contents and total of the customer's checkout, and whether they already purchased. Call this before mentioning any item, price or availability.

name: send_checkout_link
description: Send the customer a link to complete their checkout. Use when they want to finish the order or are busy.

channel.description: Where to send the link: 'sms' by default, or 'whatsapp' if the customer asks for it.

name: opt_out
description: Add the customer's number to the do-not-call list. Use immediately if they ask not to be called, say it is a wrong number, are not the named customer, or are upset.
